title: Data manipulation (defacement)
hypothesis: An attacker modified web content or databases.
queries: DeviceFileEvents | where FolderPath contains 'inetpub' or FolderPath contains 'wwwroot' | where ActionType in ('FileModified','FileCreated') | where InitiatingProcessFileName != 'w3wp.exe'
rationale: Non-server writes to web root = defacement.
